repository.name: agid-postal-la
repository.purpose: Laos postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.legal_rule: Lao Postal Services Law No. 45/NA dated 25 December 2013 defines a postcode as an indicator number for location and the scope of postal-item delivery, comprising province or capital, district, municipality and village delivery codes. The same law defines the postal network as post offices, mail exchange centres and mail routes. Lao Postal Service and Laopedia provide current public references. These establish syntax, assignment context and area-or-non-area semantics, not bulk reuse, canonical national postal polygons, exact civic addresses, buildings or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store a postcode as a five-character digit string preserving leading zeroes. Production assignment requires an exact current Lao Postal Service or other legally authorised rights-cleared record with code, object type, authority, validity, retrieval timestamp, response schema and digest pinned. Laopedia rows, law text, post-office names, P.O. boxes, mail routes, village names, census tables, administrative codes, coordinates and proximity do not independently create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Laos postcode polygon artifact is bundled. A postal-authority surface requires an exact geometry artifact and postcode relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining a proven assignment to a separately permitted province or district boundary remains a derived postal-administrative join surface with uncertainty. Post offices, P.O. boxes, mail exchange centres and mail routes remain point, route or non-area objects unless the postal authority proves an area. Administrative boundaries, village names, census geography, Voronoi, interpolation, OSM and models never become official postal polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organisation, unit, building or house number, street or route, village, district, province or capital, P.O. Box and postcode remain typed, sourced and validity-aware. A postcode, post office, mail route, administrative containment, census building, coordinate, parcel, address query or map feature alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit, exact legal civic address or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building geometry with purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Census GIS and LaoLandReg evidence are not public address-building datasets. Postcode containment, post-office or route proximity, village or street match, parcel overlap, coordinate equality and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A postal object or derived surface may link to AGID cells through an explicit versioned crosswalk without relabelling a postcode, province, district, village, P.O. Box, route, parcel, address or building as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is postal-authority geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Pin publisher, exact item or service URL, publication and download dates, terms or licence version, attribution, fields, CRS, schema and digest for every production artifact. Lao Post, Laopedia, laws, NFMS viewers or ArcGIS endpoints, LSB pages, project documents and public access do not grant blanket row, layer, address, census, cadastral or building redistribution rights. Blank copyright metadata is not an open licence.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. Box holders, postcode and address queries, household or dwelling records, building locations, phones, emails, identities, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, parcels, land-register records, access credentials and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Apply the current Electronic Data Law and exact approvals before access, transfer or publication; only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.
